endorsements.name: Víctor Fresco Perales
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-4045
endorsements.description: TP-Link Tapo C200 IP camera, on its 1.1.15 firmware version and below, is affected by an unauthenticated RCE vulnerability, present in the uhttpd binary running by default as root. The exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to take full control of the camera.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

endorsements.name: Víctor Fresco Perales
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-40634
endorsements.description: Stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the 'conn-indicator' binary running as root on the TP-Link Archer AX50 router, in firmware versions prior to 1.0.15 build 241203 rel61480. This vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the device over LAN and WAN networks.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.2)
